purpose: PR16 merge-readiness confirmation; fixed before measurement; no numerical or kernel change.
source_freeze: Record compiled source and executable hashes after harness-only evidence additions and tests, before timing. All sessions use the same ordinary binary.
pair_order: Alternating baseline/shared for odd repeats, shared/baseline for even repeats, as the existing benchmark.
scope: Steady-state full-model decode including vocabulary projection, finite-logit scan, greedy selection and token recording. Loading, prepared KV, full-range warmup, validation and reporting excluded. EOS is an ordinary token in this fixed-step benchmark.
evidence_additions: Untimed warmup hashes every complete logit row at every step; each measured run retains UNIX start time, warmup duration and optional outside-the-loop process CPU/fault/context-switch deltas. Timed arithmetic and outputs are unchanged.

performance_acceptance.primary: Keep the existing median of paired baseline/candidate elapsed ratios and its deterministic 10000-resample paired-bootstrap descriptive interval.
performance_acceptance.interpretation: Both sessions must support the declared throughput/regression limits. The additional aggregate, tail and order checks prevent a favorable median from hiding operational regression; they do not relax the original targets. Bootstrap assumptions and desktop interference remain limitations, not permission to drop observations.

correctness_acceptance: Complete timed token arrays, finite logits and final hashes match; untimed all-step logits match; expected attention path/count and configuration verified in every run. Profiling must be disabled.

lifecycle_acceptance.mixed: Two ordinary interleaved repeats for baseline/shared, fixed millisecond arrivals, exact complete outputs, four successful requests, eight length completions,336 output tokens, no OOM/rejection/preemption, positive shared calls only when enabled and deadline-derived latency accounting.
lifecycle_acceptance.pressure: One repeat across roomy192 baseline, tight132 baseline and tight132 shared; exact128 output tokens and two length completions against roomy oracle; both tight runs must preempt/recompute/COW and reach132 allocated blocks; shared kernel must execute when enabled.
lifecycle_acceptance.eos: Real-engine traces override EOS to valid token0 and clear extra EOS IDs. Any early EOS or missed pressure invariant makes the observation invalid and reported; do not select replacement prompts after seeing timings.

host_controls: No concurrent project builds, tests, benchmarks or sampling loop during timing. Preserve a lightweight load/thermal snapshot before and after each process. Desktop applications remain running; the host is not claimed isolated or noise-free.
retention: Keep every completed and partial run, all inputs and raw reports. Stop after the declared sessions; do not rerun until passing or pool sources. Investigate failures without claiming merge readiness.
analysis: Report each session separately, including paired ratios and intervals, aggregate throughput, pooled p95/p99/max, per-run tails and order strata. Resource counters are diagnostic, not causal attribution.
